subject: general
question:
Which of the following has the maximum electrical resistivity?

Silver, Copper, Iron, Nichrome
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nichrome**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Of all the materials, **nichrome **has the **highest **resistance.
 
• **Chromium, nickel, **and **iron** are combined to create **nichrome**.
 
• These metals are **composed **of:
 
 
• Cr=**15%**
 
• Ni=**60%**
 
• Fe=**25%**
 
 
 
• **Brightray **is another name for Nichrome.
 
• Due to the extremely high resistance that opposes the flow of electric current and consequently generates a lot of **heat**, it exhibits the **heating effect **of **electric current**.
 
• Nichrome alloy therefore has the highest resistivity, **1.10× 10-⁶ Ω****m. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• A **force **that **opposes **the flow of **current **is called **resistance**.
 
• Resistivity, then, is the particular resistance of a particular **conductor **(material) of a particular **size **(length and area of cross-section).
 
• Additionally called** electrical resistivity.**
 
• The symbol **(ρ) "rho"** is used to represent it.
 
• The** "ohm-meter," **which can alternatively be written as** Ωm,** is the **SI unit of resistivity. **
